C-COORDINATOR-BOUNDARY-1-CB86E900.IntentSummary: Two serial tasks, then the closed ceremony. T-001 creates the supervisor module (src/test-support/coordinator.ts, LINKS: M-TEST-SUPPORT), writes its focused behavior suite (src/test-support/coordinator.test.ts), and makes the M-TEST-SUPPORT scope truthful in its header, graph summary, and verification scenario; its verification is the focused suite against the module it just created, plus typecheck. T-002 depends on T-001 and regenerates test-metrics.json from one measured run through a red-to-green artifact guard that requires a metrics identity for each of T-001's six coordinator criteria. The target gate is bun run validate:ci under --assertions final --run-commands; AC-CLOSE-LINT is evaluated post-archive. ObservedWriteScope carries the six forced paths and this bundle's own archive arrival.

T-001.Title: Create the supervisor module, its focused behavior suite, and the truthful M-TEST-SUPPORT scope

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Red first (pre-implementation probe, not a baseline assertion): an existence guard fails before implementation because src/test-support/coordinator.ts is absent. Then create src/test-support/coordinator.ts with the module header LINKS: M-TEST-SUPPORT and a contract that preflights a plan before any spawn or workspace creation using canonical (symlink-resolved) containment, refusing the twenty cases enumerated in AC-COORDINATOR-PREFLIGHT-REFUSES: duplicate worker ids; equal workspaces; nested workspaces; symlink-aliased workspaces; an output escaping its own workspace; two outputs with the same name across workers; an output equal to a reserved log path; a start-gate path inside a workspace; a startAfterTimeoutMs of zero, negative, NaN, and Infinity; a global deadline of zero, negative, NaN, and Infinity; a workspace that contains project/; a workspace nested inside project/; a workspace that contains control/; and a workspace nested inside control/. The module exports a runner that creates each workers/<id> workspace, spawns direct workers in plan order (a worker may be staged behind a bounded, finite startAfterPath gate), drains each worker's stdout and stderr into that worker's own logs, returns only after every direct worker has exited or the finite global deadline is reached, and bounded-kills and reaps every still-running direct worker, naming an unreaped PID explicitly. On any spawn, gate, output-read, or stream-pump failure it stops immediately, bounded-kills and reaps every already-started direct worker, and propagates the original error composed with any cleanup failure; a stream-pump fault interrupts every phase, including the staged gate wait. A declared output is snapshotted only after its owning worker exits; only direct worker PIDs are guaranteed. Write src/test-support/coordinator.test.ts covering all six ordinary criteria, with each focused test title carrying its AC id. The preflight test drives all twenty cases through runCoordinator with a spawn spy, asserting the intended refusal reason, zero spawns, and no newly created workspace, accounting for deliberately precreated symlink and root fixtures. The fail-fast cleanup test drives a plainly running first worker and a gated spawn failure, with cleanup-skip red and restored. The remaining fail-fast branches are covered explicitly: an unreadable present output (a directory passed as a declared output) throws after cleanup; a worker exit 7 is returned as data and does not throw; and a failed kill or reap returns a bounded error naming the unreaped PID. The real-CLI test uses directly staged publisher and contender, a while-held contemporaneous check that the contender started and is pending with no plan.xml and spec.xml bytes equal to a paused-write SHA-256 baseline before the control/ release, then final exits, no plan or marker or lock, and byte equality again, with a planted byte mutation reddening the hold comparison and restored. Bounded termination and both global-deadline precedence directions are covered. Stream faults are covered in the running phase (ignore-pump red, restored) and during the staged gate wait, each verified by direct-PID liveness after the throw, with any deliberately leaked red-control PID killed before the throwaway root is removed. Also extend the PURPOSE and SCOPE of the src/test-support/fixtures.ts module header, the M-TEST-SUPPORT Summary in .ngrace/graph/main.xml, and the V-M-TEST-SUPPORT Scenario and TraceAssertion in .ngrace/verification/main.xml to describe the supervisor. Do not pin a projected test or metrics count.

T-002.Title: Invalidate and regenerate the measured test-metrics.json

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Red first: the artifact guard below rejects the committed test-metrics.json because it does not yet carry the coordinator test identities. Then invalidate the committed test-metrics.json so the runner's file-set-and-count-sum freshness predicate cannot leave it untouched, and run the artifact-producing action exactly once with bun run test:metrics; this is the single artifact-producing run. After it, the same guard passes: at least one metrics case identity for each of T-001's six coordinator criteria (AC-COORDINATOR-PREFLIGHT-REFUSES, AC-COORDINATOR-AWAITS-ALL, AC-COORDINATOR-TIMEOUT-KILLS, AC-COORDINATOR-DEADLINE-PRECEDENCE, AC-COORDINATOR-FAIL-FAST-CLEANUP, AC-COORDINATOR-STREAM-FAULT), no (provisional) entry, and a per-file count sum equal to the case count. scripts/test-metrics.ts is not edited, and no projected figure is asserted. A later bun run validate:ci invokes test:metrics again, but a fresh artifact is left untouched (scripts/test-metrics.ts:78-130) and is not a second artifact-producing run.

Verification.Command: bun -e 'const fs=require("fs");const a=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync("test-metrics.json","utf8"));const need=["AC-COORDINATOR-PREFLIGHT-REFUSES","AC-COORDINATOR-AWAITS-ALL","AC-COORDINATOR-TIMEOUT-KILLS","AC-COORDINATOR-DEADLINE-PRECEDENCE","AC-COORDINATOR-FAIL-FAST-CLEANUP","AC-COORDINATOR-STREAM-FAULT"];const missing=need.filter(id=>!a.tests.some(t=>t.file==="src/test-support/coordinator.test.ts"&&t.name.includes(id)));const provisional=a.tests.filter(x=>x.name==="(provisional)");const sum=a.files.reduce((s,f)=>s+f.tests,0);if(missing.length)throw new Error("missing coordinator identities: "+missing.join(","));if(provisional.length||sum!==a.tests.length)throw new Error("stale: provisional="+provisional.length+" sum="+sum+"/"+a.tests.length);console.log("artifact current:",a.tests.length,"cases; coordinator ids present:",need.length);'
